# railway_project (Data Source)

Railway project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_project" "example" {
  id = "0bb01547-570d-4109-a5e8-138691f6a2d1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the project.

### Read-Only

- `default_environment_id` (String) Identifier of the default (oldest) environment.
- `description` (String) Description of the project.
- `environments` (Attributes List) Environments of the project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--environments))
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the project is public.
- `name` (String) Name of the project.
- `pr_deploys` (Boolean) Whether pull request deploys are enabled.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace the project belongs to.

<a id="nestedatt--environments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `environments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identifier of the environment.
- `name` (String) Name of the environment.
